entities.summary: Christopher Greenup was an American politician who served as a U.S. Representative and the third governor of Kentucky. Little is known about his early life; the first reliable records about him are documents recording his service in the Revolutionary War where he served as a lieutenant in the Continental Army and a colonel in the Virginia militia.
